questiontext.text:
Question ID: GEO_U06_UA_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.GEO.CGM.7

Point P partitions segment AB in the ratio AP:PB = 3:1. If A(0, 0) and B(8, 4), what is P?

feedback.text: That point is 1/4 of the way from A to B, not 3/4.
AP is 3 of 4 total parts, so P is 3/4 of the way from A to B: (6, 3).
That is endpoint B, not a 3:1 partition point.

feedback.text: A circle centered at the origin has x?+y?=r?.
This is linear, not a circle equation.
The right side should be r?.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: GEO_U06_UA_Q10

MLA Standard: MLA.GEO.CGM.11

A cylinder is sliced parallel to its base. What is the cross-section? Choose the most precise answer.

feedback.text: That may occur with a perpendicular slice.
This slice does not form a triangle.
A parabola is a conic section, not this cylinder slice.
A base-parallel slice of a cylinder is circular.

questiontext.text:

MLA Standard: MLA.GEO.CGM.12

Which rotation creates a cylinder? Choose the most precise answer.

answer.text: Rotating a triangle around a leg
Rotating a rectangle around one side

feedback.text: A rectangle rotated around one side creates a cylinder.

answer.text: Rotating a semicircle around its diameter

feedback.text: That does not create a cylinder with volume.
